subject: Columbus Elementary School Renaming Procedures
overview: The School Committee approved a memorandum of agreement for paraprofessionals and voted to waive student athletic fees for the current school year. Significant discussion addressed the operational preparations for state-mandated increases in in-person learning and the procedural timeline for renaming the Columbus Elementary School.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee entered executive session to discuss the negotiation process for the superintendent's contract.

items.title: Routine Business
items.summary: Approved the minutes from February 8, 2021, and routine financial bills, fund transfers, and payrolls.

items.title: Subcommittee Reports
items.summary: Approved reports from the Curriculum, Committee of the Whole, and Stakeholder Engagement subcommittees concerning educational technology, world language pathways, the superintendent's evaluation, and community roundtables.

items.title: Building and Ground Subcommittee
items.summary: Approved designating the high school generator replacement as a high-priority capital item and authorized the district to seek cost estimates for new high school signage.

items.title: Superintendent Update and COVID-19 Report
items.summary: The superintendent reported zero positive COVID-19 cases in schools and discussed vaccine eligibility for staff and the phased return to full-time in-person instruction.

items.title: Unity Poetry Contest
items.summary: Winners of the district-wide Unity Poetry Contest were recognized and recited poems centered on themes of inclusivity and racial justice.

items.title: McGlynn Middle School Report
items.summary: Principal Nick Tucci presented an update on student resilience, honor roll growth, and various virtual guest speakers and assemblies held during the school year.

items.title: Secondary Cohort Assignment Deadline
items.summary: Discussed the March 12 deadline for students in grades 6-12 to commit to hybrid or remote cohorts to provide operational stability for future scheduling changes.

items.title: Paraprofessional Association MOA
items.summary: Approved a memorandum of agreement with the Medford Paraprofessionals Association regarding working conditions for the current school year.

items.title: High School Restroom Renovation
items.summary: Received an update on the progress of bidding for restroom renovations at the high school and the potential expansion of the project scope to additional facilities.

items.title: Athletic User Fees
items.summary: Approved waiving student athletic fees for the 2020-2021 academic year due to significantly shortened seasons and reduced program costs.

items.title: Policy Amendments and Voting Tallies
items.summary: Approved changing the frequency of tiered monitoring reports to every three years and voted to include school committee voting tallies in regular public records.

items.title: Columbus Elementary School Renaming Resolutions
items.summary: Referred resolutions regarding the advisory committee guidelines and timeline for renaming the school to the Committee of the Whole following the reading of public testimony and petitions.
